evidence_provenance: Historical RED/GREEN logs retain their own source snapshot and are not presented as new reruns.
Final-review snapshot replayed six existing methods, zero skips; this is not six newly authored tests.
Approval receipt-provenance.log records 34 passing methods but no command/method list; no finer attribution is invented.
Owner final integrated test run, clean extraction and archive hashes are separate release gates. No success is inferred from an in-progress run.

control: approval_authority.ApprovedExecution._check rechecks time and revocation after callback
findings.invariant: Authority must remain active after each bounded host recheck.
limits: No cloud issuer or live operation was involved.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Approval expired or was revoked during a host callback

findings.invariant: Expired or rejected authority must prevent child startup.
limits: Harmless local marker process; no provider or cloud mutation.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Child process launched before the first active-authority check

control: approval_authority._valid_public_key uses pinned native validator and documented subgroup workaround
findings.invariant: Installed issuer keys must be canonical, non-small-order, main-subgroup points.
limits: Requires installing an invalid weak trusted key; valid generated issuer keys were not demonstrated forgeable.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Installed weak Ed25519 identity key accepted a static signature forgery

control: approval_authority._valid_public_key loads verified bytes through a unique private pathname and bounded content cache
findings.invariant: Executed validator bytes must match the selected pin.
limits: Protected loader, native dependencies and interpreter remain trusted.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Recycled loader descriptor pathname selected a previously loaded validator image

findings.invariant: Unavailable verifier dependencies must fail closed with a fixed diagnostic.
limits: Pre-fix behavior already denied authorization; this was diagnostic/API consistency.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Missing validator escaped the fixed application-error contract

control: identity_binding._NativeTransport cancels on BaseException and checks cancellation after connect
findings.invariant: Caller cancellation must prevent a not-yet-dispatched credential request.
limits: Identity counterpart was fixed before combined independent RED log; no persisted identity RED log is claimed. Already-sent bytes cannot be undone.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Caller interruption could leave a delayed identity credential dispatch running

control: identity_binding._NativeTransport and blob_lease._LeaseTransport disable auto_open after explicit connect
findings.invariant: A cancelled request must not reconnect and send credentials or lease operations.
limits: Combined RED demonstrates lease counterpart; identity repair preceded that run. No live endpoint or credential exfiltration demonstrated.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Automatic HTTP reconnect could dispatch after a timeout closed the first connection

control: Both transports retain the connected socket for shutdown and close HTTPResponse in worker cleanup
findings.invariant: Body cancellation must terminate the response stream and release bounded worker capacity.
limits: Positive path asserts socketpair creation, stdlib detach, body read, and joined workers. This does not qualify TLS or remote Azure.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Detached HTTP response socket kept a worker alive past its deadline

control: blob_lease caps token acquisition by request deadline and prior lease expiry
findings.invariant: OAuth and lease work must share the remaining conservative lease deadline.
limits: Pre-fix code rejected lease writes after noticing expiry; excess blocking was reproduced, not an expired-owner Graph write.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Lease renewal/release token stage exceeded remaining ownership lifetime

control: blob_lease preserves terminal release state on rejected renewal
findings.invariant: Terminal lease states must remain terminal and cannot recover authority.
limits: No live Blob service operation was performed.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Renewal after release overwrote terminal receipt state

control: ProviderJourney requires exact durable authority consumption
Verified restart requires private dispatch/outcome hash and exact_plan_returned plus saved-plan/state validation
Read-only convergence without prior execution remains unconfirmed
findings.invariant: A journal, spent approval or converged state alone cannot prove exact saved-plan execution.
limits: Current-source regressions and final replay retained; no standalone persisted initial journey RED log is claimed. Same-account private-store modification is outside this boundary.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Writable journal and converged state could manufacture a verified journey outcome

control: provider_journey.read_credential_fd rejects O_PATH and uses nested-finally closure
findings.invariant: Every duplicate credential descriptor must close even if flag operations fail.
limits: No retained initial RED log; the existing regression and integrated scoped test receipt are the retained evidence. No actual credential store was read.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Path-only credential descriptor leaked its duplicate during cleanup

control: identity_binding._Observer.read enforces aggregate header length in addition to native transport checks
findings.invariant: All admitted response paths must enforce the documented header budget.
limits: Native transport already had a 64 KiB aggregate check; this finding concerns the shared/injected response-validation path.
findings.severity_basis: Supplemental qualitative impact assessment; no CVSS score or live exploit claim.
findings.title: Injected response validation omitted the aggregate header bound

closure_requirement: Qualify provider RPC, Configure, schema, import, update and readback on a host meeting the required boundary.
open_gaps.observation: Native init passed; schema and validate were blocked and AF_UNIX socket creation returned errno 1.
open_gaps.title: Native provider RPC and lifecycle qualification remains blocked

closure_requirement: Provision explicit protected credentials and independently observe real service targets, permissions, failures and readback.
open_gaps.observation: Recorded identities/leases prove contract logic only; no real tenant or live service calls occurred.
open_gaps.title: No live identity, RBAC, TLS, Graph, ARM or Blob qualification

closure_requirement: Design and qualify native Azure backend locking and same-credential target linkage without double lease ownership.
open_gaps.observation: Provider uses local state with IP denial; a separately acquired state-blob lease conflicts with OpenTofu acquiring its own backend lease.
open_gaps.title: Live identity, Azure backend and provider execution are not joined

closure_requirement: Enforce and positively test filesystem and Unix endpoint isolation on the deployment host; do not remove IP denial to obtain a pass.
open_gaps.observation: Allowed Unix endpoints and filesystem access need a qualified host boundary.
open_gaps.title: IP denial is not a complete execution sandbox

closure_requirement: Qualify deployment-wide ownership and service-specific concurrency controls before any live mutation.
open_gaps.observation: Azure Blob lease scope and same-store mutexes cannot exclude unrelated Intune/Graph writers.
open_gaps.title: Blob leases and cooperative locks do not fence Graph writers

closure_requirement: Provision independent issuer trust, policy custody, revocation, backup/recovery, and protected durable store controls.
open_gaps.observation: Fixture private keys exercise mechanics; they do not establish organizational approver identity or durable trust operations.
open_gaps.title: Organizational issuer and protected-store operations remain deployment gates

closure_requirement: Retain independent end-to-end admission and preservation evidence for the supported capture/configuration slice.
open_gaps.observation: The journey accepts a separately admitted generated executor; source/admission hashes are bindings, not proof of complete semantic admission.
open_gaps.title: Capture-to-generated-configuration admission is not fully qualified

threat_boundary: Protected Python interpreter, same-account credential-holding process, operator policy/store and native trust dependencies remain trusted.
A malicious same-account writer or compromised interpreter can alter private capabilities/store; no security-domain isolation claim is made.
Separate review agents share filesystem/context; review is neither blinded nor organizational AppSec certification.
No live-service call, real credential retrieval, production mutation, test rerun or environment inspection is performed by this supplemental builder.
